name: Ikonisys S.A.
summary: Based in Paris, France, Ikonisys S.A. is a company specializing in cell-based diagnostics. It develops, produces, and commercializes medical diagnostic solutions for various cancers across the United States and Europe. Their core offering includes the Ikoniscope Robotic Microscope, which automates slide manipulation, scanning, and real-time image acquisition and analysis, thereby minimizing human error during diagnostic testing. The company provides a suite of specialized oncoFISH microscopy applications for cancer detection and characterization, such as oncoFISH bladder for analyzing urine samples, oncoFISH her2 for determining HER2 status in breast tissue biopsies, oncoFISH ALK for identifying rearrangements of the ALK gene, and oncoFISH PTEN for detecting PTEN gene deletions in prostate tissue biopsies. Ikonisys also offers tools for characterizing individual circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and analyzing circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) to provide comprehensive tumor genotype information. Additionally, their Ikonisoft explorer software suite features dedicated FISH scanning applications: Ikonisoft explorer CS for cell suspensions on slides, and Ikonisoft explorer tissue for examining hybridized tissue sections. Finally, the IkoniWAN Gateway provides a secure, validated remote access solution for their Ikoniscope digital microscopy platforms.
